title: Palo Alto Networks reports Q1 revenue up 39% YoY to $3.45B, above $3.31B est., and raises its FY 2027 revenue forecast; PANW jumps 7%+ after hours (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Palo Alto Networks reports Q1 revenue up 39% YoY to $3.45B, above $3.31B est., and raises its FY 2027 revenue forecast; PANW jumps 7%+ after hours — Cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks (PANW.O) raised its annual revenue forecast and signed a deal to acquire AI startup Applied Compute …
